(Currently Amended) Claim 8: A composition comprising a lubricant comprising at least one selected from the group consisting of polyol ester and polyvinyl ether, and a refrigerant comprising: from 1 to 99% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf); and from 1 to 99% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze), wherein said composition is a refrigeration composition that exhibits a Hazen color of about 200 or less as measured by ASHRAE test 97-2007 after a sealed glass tube comprising the composition is welded closed and placed in an oven at 200 °C for 14 days.

(Currently Amended) Claim 17: The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the refrigerant comprises from 5 to 45% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf) and from 55 to 95% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze), and wherein the lubricant is selected to ensure compatibility with the refrigerant.

(Currently Amended) Claim 18: The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the refrigerant comprises from 15 to 45% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf) and from 55 to 85% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze), and wherein the lubricant is selected to ensure compatibility with the refrigerant.

(Currently Amended) Claim 19: The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the refrigerant comprises from 15 to 35% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf) and from 65 to 85% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze), and wherein the lubricant is selected to ensure compatibility with the refrigerant.

(Currently Amended) Claim 25: The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the refrigerant further comprises 1,1,1,2-tetrafluoroethane as a co-refrigerant.
